solutions.description: Combine solutions A and B; load into a 50-mL syringe in the drybox.
solutions.injected_fraction: the syringe contents in a single injection
solutions.source_consistency_note: Individual listed liquid volumes sum nominally to 51.0 mL, whereas the article says a 50-mL syringe. Preserve those source values. Do not silently change a component volume, equate syringe capacity to measured injected volume, or assume ideal volume additivity.

synthesis_steps.action: Dry and degas TOPO in the reaction vessel.
Stabilize the reaction flask temperature under argon.
Prepare solutions A and B, combine and load into a 50-mL syringe in the drybox.
synthesis_steps.order_note: The paper presents bath preparation before stock preparation; these preparations precede injection and may occur independently.

synthesis_steps.action: Remove heat from the reaction vessel; quickly take the syringe from the drybox and inject its contents once through a rubber septum into the vigorously stirred bath.
Observe a rapid temperature drop and initial nanocrystal formation after injection.
synthesis_steps.caution: 440-460 nm is the immediate post-injection absorption feature, not the final fluorescence wavelength.

synthesis_steps.action: Restore heating and gradually raise temperature.
Monitor aliquot absorption and adjust growth temperature to maintain steady growth with a narrow size distribution.
synthesis_steps.duration_description: a few hours for best-quality samples

feedback.observation: size distribution broadens, estimated from absorption spectra

synthesis_steps.action: When desired absorption characteristics are reached, transfer a portion by cannula into a vial.
synthesis_steps.caution: Different withdrawn portions yield different sizes; the protocol does not map an exact growth time to each size.

purification.scope: One 10-mL aliquot of reaction solution, not the entire batch.

steps.action: Withdraw an aliquot by cannula and cool to slightly above the TOPO melting point.
Add anhydrous methanol to reversibly flocculate nanocrystallites.
Centrifuge to separate flocculate from supernatant.
Disperse flocculate in anhydrous 1-butanol; centrifuge again.
steps.discard: gray precipitate, mostly elemental Cd and Se byproduct

steps.action: Add anhydrous methanol to the supernatant to flocculate crystallites and remove excess TOP/TOPO.
Vacuum dry to obtain free-flowing TOP/TOPO-capped CdSe powder.

product_mass.basis: from the stated 10-mL reaction aliquot; capped nanocrystal powder
product_mass.caution: This is not a reported whole-batch yield or the mass of bare CdSe alone.

optional_postprocessing.title: Size-selective precipitation

steps.action: Disperse purified nanocrystallites in anhydrous 1-butanol to an optically clear solution.
Add anhydrous methanol dropwise until opalescence persists upon stirring or sonication.
Centrifuge to separate supernatant and flocculate.
steps.retain: precipitate enriched in the largest crystallites

steps.action: Redisperse precipitate in 1-butanol and repeat methanol size selection.
steps.endpoint: no further sharpening of the optical absorption spectrum

optional_postprocessing.caution: Do not replace this endpoint-based repeat with a universal fixed three-wash recipe. Figure 1 is an illustrated fractionation series, not a prescribed number for every batch.

optional_postprocessing.title: Separate pyridine ligand-exchange branch
steps: Heat crystallites with pyridine until gradually dispersed.
Repeat pyridine dispersion and hexane flocculation a number of times.
optional_postprocessing.reported_solubility_after_exchange: Readily disperses in pyridine, methanol and aromatics; no longer disperses in aliphatics.
optional_postprocessing.caution: Not part of the base TOP/TOPO-capped synthesis. Surface exchange can reduce average size and broaden its distribution (PDF4).

other_materials_and_routes.topte_preparation: Dissolve tellurium shot in TOP; Te shot electronic-grade 99.99+%, Alfa.
other_materials_and_routes.caution: Do not relabel CdSe measurements or workup mass as CdTe results.

other_materials_and_routes.change: Replace phosphine chalcogenide precursors with silyl chalcogenides, respectively.

size_definition.description: All reported diameters are the major axis of slightly prolate crystallites, not a spherical diameter or necessarily an equivalent-volume diameter.

structure.description: Predominantly wurtzite, with stacking faults along the elongated (002) direction; bulk-like average bond lengths. Pure wurtzite or pure zincblende labels alone are potentially misleading.

smallest_cluster_exception.description: Authors state that too few atoms define a core crystal structure for the wurtzite/zincblende distinction to be meaningful.

examples.description: Size-selection sharpens absorption and narrows a sample from about 35 A +/-10% to about 37 A +/-5%.
examples.wavelength_note: The 400 nm transition is approximate; these are newly resolved higher-energy features, not a reported PL peak.

examples.measurement: room-temperature absorption of CdSe dispersed in hexane
examples.labels_note: The three smallest size labels carry approximate signs; numerical conversion to nm does not add precision.

examples.sample_identity_note: Do not automatically merge this optical sample with the Figure 6 TEM sample merely because both have a 35 A major-axis size.

examples.orientation: long axis along the wurtzite (002) direction
examples.measurement_caution: The discussion describes size-distribution standard deviations as measurement-limited, with uncertainty of one atomic plane per crystallite. Percent values are not a single-particle instrumental error bar.

examples.observation: Individual crystal with stacking faults in (002) direction.

examples.note: If deriving a short axis for an illustrative model, mark it as calculated from approximate size and aspect ratio, not directly measured.

examples.observation: Near-monolayer showing short-range hexagonal close packing.

examples.caution: This diffraction size series is not identical to the Figure 3 optical size series.

critical_missing_fields: Detailed dissolution conditions for preparing the 1.0 M TOPSe stock, including temperature and time.
Specific reagent lot numbers and most numerical purity values; named suppliers and Se/Te electronic grades ARE reported.
Reaction-flask capacity and detailed geometry; stirring rpm.
Exact injection duration and independently measured total injection volume.
Exact heating ramp, temperature-versus-time trajectory and numerical feedback thresholds.
Exact growth duration, sampling history and temperature history linked to each reported particle-size sample.
Growth-monitoring aliquot volume; the later 10-mL purification aliquot must not be assigned automatically to every monitoring sample.
Centrifugation forces/speeds and durations, vacuum drying pressure, time and temperature.
Fixed size-selection solvent volumes, number of cycles and final recovery; process is endpoint-based.
Isolated whole-batch product yield or conversion; approximately 300 mg is reported for one 10-mL aliquot and includes capping material.
Full numerical protocols for CdS/CdTe and Method 2 variants beyond the reported substitutions and temperature ranges.
A unique atom-by-atom structure for any individual product; ideal-lattice models omit measured stacking faults and surface disorder.

recommended_display.main_story: Prepare separate A/B solutions; inject once to separate nucleation from growth; monitor and adapt temperature; withdraw sizes; purify; optionally narrow the distribution.
recommended_display.suggested_default_structural_example: Figure 6 TEM: 3.5 x 3.0 nm, clearly labeled separately from the Figure 5 optical sample.
recommended_display.safe_model_label: Illustrative prolate CdSe model using a wurtzite reference; experimental samples include stacking faults and surface disorder.
recommended_display.thermal_sequence: ~200 C / ~20 min vacuum degas -> ~300 C argon stabilization -> injection drop to ~180 C -> gradual reheating to230-260 C -> adaptive growth over a few hours. Only sampling interval and degas duration are numerical time data.
no_fabricated_controls: Fixed numerical total syringe volume substituted for source component volumes
9.6% quantum yield assigned to every product size
CdS/CdTe precursor temperatures inserted into the selected CdSe workflow
Optional pyridine exchange shown as a required base-recipe step
